description: Fix all P2 and P3 code quality issues from the code review: extract magic numbers, add versioned state schema for RiskManager, improve error swallowing, replace unconditional VACUUM, and add TODO comment for jupiter.ts unused imports.
steps: P2-6: Create src/constants.ts with named exports for commonly-used magic numbers found across the codebase. Include at minimum: LOW_BALANCE_THRESHOLD (from agent.ts), HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS (from agent.ts), MAX_RETRIES and BASE_BACKOFF_MS (from jupiter.ts), MAX_SCAN_QUEUE_SIZE (from telegram/commands/security.ts), PRUNE_RETENTION_DAYS (30, from agent.ts scheduler), RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS (60000, from mcp.ts), DEFAULT_RISK_LIMITS values. Update the source files to import from constants.ts instead of defining locally.

P2-7: In src/core/risk.ts persistState(), add a `schemaVersion: 1` field to the serialized JSON. In restoreState(), check for the schemaVersion field when parsing. If missing or not matching current version, log a warning and skip restoration (start fresh). This protects against loading incompatible state.

P2-8: In src/core/agent.ts and src/index.ts, find all empty catch blocks (catch { } or catch (error) { } with no body/only a comment) and add appropriate logger.warn() or logger.debug() calls to log the error. In agent.ts getState() catch block, add logger.debug. In any other empty catches, add at minimum a logger.debug with the error message.

P2-10: In src/core/memory.ts prune() method, replace unconditional VACUUM with conditional execution. After deletions, only run VACUUM if (decisionsResult.changes + observationsResult.changes) > 0. This avoids expensive VACUUM on days with no pruning.

P3-11: In src/integrations/jupiter.ts, add a TODO comment above the `import { Connection, Keypair, VersionedTransaction }` line noting these imports are only used in the deprecated signAndSendSwapLegacy function and can be removed when that function is removed.
acceptance_criteria: src/constants.ts exists with named exports for key magic numbers
Source files import from constants.ts rather than defining magic numbers inline (at least agent.ts, jupiter.ts, security.ts command)
RiskManager persistState includes schemaVersion, restoreState validates it
No empty catch blocks remain in agent.ts or index.ts
VACUUM only runs when records were actually deleted
jupiter.ts has TODO comment about deprecated imports
